main.node: MySQL - load up to 32 candidate texts

parameters.query:
UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_texts AS t
JOIN JSON_TABLE(
    $1,
    '$[*]' COLUMNS (
        TextUUID   VARCHAR(36) PATH '$.TextUUID',
        newStatus  VARCHAR(32) PATH '$.newStatus',
        reason     VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.reason' NULL ON EMPTY
    )
) AS u
    ON t.TextUUIDBin = UUID_TO_BIN_MDB(u.TextUUID)
SET
    t.TextStatus =
        CONVERT(u.newStatus USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,

    t.TextFailedReason =
        CONVERT(u.reason USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci

WHERE
       t.TextStatus COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
       <>
       CONVERT(u.newStatus USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci

    OR NOT (
        t.TextFailedReason COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
        <=>
        CONVERT(u.reason USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
    );

INSERT INTO infofee01_rag.if_extraction_log (
    TextUUIDBin,
    Stage,
    Status,
    Message,
    LoggedAt
)
SELECT
    UUID_TO_BIN_MDB(u.TextUUID),
    'finalize',
    u.newStatus,
    CONCAT(
        'auto-reconciled text to ',
        u.newStatus,
        CASE
            WHEN u.reason IS NOT NULL
                THEN CONCAT(' reason=', u.reason)
            ELSE ''
        END
    ),
    NOW()
FROM JSON_TABLE(
    $1,
    '$[*]' COLUMNS (
        TextUUID   VARCHAR(36) PATH '$.TextUUID',
        newStatus  VARCHAR(32) PATH '$.newStatus',
        reason     VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.reason' NULL ON EMPTY
    )
) AS u;

nodes.name: MySQL - load up to 32 candidate texts

parameters.query:
SELECT
    BIN_TO_UUID_MDB(t.TextUUIDBin) AS TextUUID,
    t.TextStatus,
    t.TextID,

    COUNT(c.ChunkUUIDBin) AS ChunkCount,

    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN c.ChunkEmbedding IS NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS ChunksWithoutEmbedding,

    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN c.EmbedStatus = 'failed' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS FailedEmbeddingChunks

FROM infofee01_rag.if_texts AS t

JOIN infofee01_rag.if_chunks AS c
    ON c.TextUUIDBin = t.TextUUIDBin

WHERE t.TextStatus IN ('pending', 'processing', 'ready', 'failed')

GROUP BY
    t.TextUUIDBin,
    t.TextStatus,
    t.TextID

HAVING
       (
           SUM(CASE WHEN c.EmbedStatus = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
           AND t.TextStatus <> 'failed'
       )

    OR (
           SUM(CASE WHEN c.EmbedStatus = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
           AND SUM(CASE WHEN c.ChunkEmbedding IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
           AND t.TextStatus <> 'pending'
       )

    OR (
           SUM(CASE WHEN c.EmbedStatus = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
           AND SUM(CASE WHEN c.ChunkEmbedding IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
           AND t.TextStatus <> 'ready'
       )

ORDER BY t.TextUUIDBin
LIMIT 32;
